source.description: Project parser/load point where attacker-controlled OpenPGP algorithm-attribute blob data is read from the card object.

sink.description: Out-of-bounds WRITE to the fixed OID stack array while copying bytes from an attacker-controlled blob.

root_cause.description: The OID copy loop is bounded only by blob->len - 1 and does not cap j to SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS, the destination array capacity.

taint_source.description: Unscored fuzz reader boundary; the scored source is pgp_get_blob retrieving the OpenPGP algorithm attribute blob.

tainted_value_origin.description: The OpenPGP algorithm-attribute blob, including blob->len and blob->data, is obtained from attacker-controlled card data.

coarse_trace.summary: Connecting to the fuzzed card invokes the OpenPGP card initializer.
OpenPGP initialization requests card feature parsing.
Algorithm-attribute blobs are retrieved from attacker-controlled card data.
The EC OID bytes from the blob are copied into a fixed stack array without a destination bound.

fine_trace.code: oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1]; /* ignore first byte of blob (algo ID) */

grounding.evidence: Step file/line appears in sanitizer crash_stack.
Step is on a changed patch line or a patch hunk line with a patch-groundable role.

fine_trace.note: ASan reports a stack-buffer-overflow WRITE when the loop writes beyond oid.value.

root_cause_analysis.summary: The fuzzed OpenPGP card data controls an algorithm-attribute blob. pgp_get_card_features retrieves that blob and passes it to pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob. For ECDH/ECDSA algorithms, the parser copies blob bytes after the first algorithm byte into a fixed sc_object_id stack object. The loop is bounded by attacker-controlled blob->len - 1 but not by the destination capacity SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS, so an oversized blob writes past oid.value on the stack.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch changes the copy loop condition to require both `j < blob->len - 1` and `j < SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS`. This caps writes to the fixed OID destination even when the card blob advertises an oversized length.
